org.name: Community Partners Advocate of Little Saigon Sacramento

pitch.headline: Imagine a professionally run parade corps.
pitch.body: Vietnamese Americans proudly representing their community, heritage, and culture throughout Greater Sacramento by marching together in parades at American and Vietnamese events. Winning awards. Getting recognition. Inspiring every generation to come. That only happens when we pour our hearts into our arts and crafts, support each other, and stand with our roots. Little Saigon Krewe begins that journey — starting at Golden Harvest this fall. Students especially need help: breakfast, gas, and banners so clubs can show up.

timeline.headline: How we get ready
timeline.intro: Stay with Little Saigon Krewe for questions — we’ll batch anything Golden Harvest needs so your club doesn’t have to chase two organizations. Soft interest first; paperwork comes in later gates.

steps.title: Soft commit — interest
steps.body: Tell us your group intends to march, name an officer/parade contact, and share a rough headcount. Interest and contacts only — not final paperwork.

steps.when: After soft commit · early–mid Sept target
steps.title: Parental consent
steps.body: Families complete cPALSs parental authorization on our form once it’s live. This year parents or guardians provide the ride downtown — we are not running a krewe bus or a staffed light-rail escort. Cleared-to-march starts here for youth.

steps.title: Golden Harvest unit registration
steps.body: Each group still files its own Golden Harvest registration (with the note a LSK A team). We’ll walk you through it and batch questions to the parade coordinators.

steps.title: Block order inside Little Saigon
steps.body: We work with Golden Harvest on the order of krewe groups in our parade train — based on who has actually filed.

steps.title: Parade day
steps.body: Check-in ~9:00 · march 11:00 · Capitol Mall. Staging details in Transit below.

championAsk.headline: Tribe Champions
championAsk.body: Each peer tribe aims for up to three champions — stage managers, not stars — who hold the tribe sign and help people connect before the march. We’ll post confirmed names here as people step up. Until then, seats are open. (Coalition supervision of each tribe is separate from the champion role.)

ctaCard.title: Want to be a tribe champion?
ctaCard.body: Pick a tribe that fits you — or tell us where you’d help most. We aim for up to three champions on each tribe.

wishlist.headline: Fund the Krewe
wishlist.body: Cover breakfast, gas, water, or a banner so students and clubs can march. Cash check to cPALSs (memo LSK 2026) or in-kind that matches the gift. Ask which slots are still open before you commit.

items.detail: Breakfast for one student group of about 15. Groups arrive around 9:00 AM and finish by noon. Benefit: social media story — “Student breakfast presented by [You].”

transit.headline: Getting there
transit.intro: This year families drive (or take transit on their own). Little Saigon Krewe is not running a chartered bus or a staffed light-rail escort. Staging is on 9th Street at Capitol Mall. Check-in is about 9:00. If your group is bringing a float or parade vehicle, that uses the separate float line-up — not the public garages.

steps: Take a SacRT Elk Grove local bus toward Cosumnes River College (CRC) — the southern end of the Blue Line.
Board Blue Line light rail toward Watt / I-80 (downtown direction).
Exit at 8th & Capitol Station. Walk one block east to 9th St — check-in and marching line-up are on 9th at Capitol Mall.
Return: board Blue Line at 8th & Capitol toward Cosumnes River College (check the headsign), then Elk Grove bus home.
notes: Little Saigon Krewe is not meeting students at a station or escorting a youth group on the train. If you take rail, a parent or guardian rides with their own student.
Free RT (2025): SacRT provided free rides by scanning a coupon — look for the 2026 coupon in the Golden Harvest packet or from parade organizers.
Saturday schedules differ from weekday rush-hour — Elk Grove weekday-only commuter buses (e.g. E13) won’t help parade morning. Use local EG routes + Blue Line, and verify times the week before.
Light rail uses one-way streets downtown; your outbound stop and return stop may differ.
Florin / South Sacramento riders can often skip the Elk Grove bus leg and board Blue Line closer to home.
transit.agencyNote: 2025 packet: “RT – Free Ride — SacRT provides free rides by scanning the coupon.” Assuming 2026 works the same; confirm when the 2026 packet drops. That coupon is the agency path — not a separate krewe ask to SacRT.
